join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :+set prefix reset
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set prefix +
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Prefix changed to +

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :+set prefix reset
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Prefix reset to !

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set prefix
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Prefix is !

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set prefix /me
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Prefix cannot begin with /

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set prefix .me
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Prefix cannot begin with .

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set prefix long
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Prefix may only be a single character.
